runner_config.description: Configure the runner settings to specify whether ControlMonkey manages the runner or it is self-hosted.

skip_state_refresh_on_destroy.description: When enabled, the state will not get refreshed before planning the destroy operation.

branch.description: The branch that triggers the deployment of the ephemeral stack from the template. If no branch is specified, the default branch of the repository will be used.

path.description: The path to a chosen directory from the root. Default path is root directory

provider_id.description: The ControlMonkey unique ID of the connected version control system.

repo_name.description: The name of the version control repository.

vcs_info.description: The configuration of the version control to which the template is attached.

block.description: Creates, updates and destroys templates for ephemeral stack. For more information: [ControlMonkey Documentation](https://docs.controlmonkey.io/main-concepts/self-service-templates/template-for-ephemeral-stack)

id.description: The unique ID of this resource.

namespace_id.description: The unique ID of the namespace.

namespaces.description: A list of namespaces to which the template is mapped.

template_id.description: The unique ID of the template.

block.description: Creates, updates and destroys template namespaces.

blueprint_variable_managed_by.description: If value is `stack`, then the variable will be managed in the ControlMonkey stack instead of tfVars file. Otherwise, if `inCode`, the variable will be managed in tfVars file.

display_name.description: Display name provides the flexibility to assign a descriptive name to the variable. This name will be shown in the UI. It can be useful especially for self service variables to make the variables more user-friendly.

id.description: The unique ID of the variable.

is_overridable.description: Indicates if the variable can be overridden by a lower-level scope.

is_required.description: This setting applies to template variables without a specified value. Stacks created from the template need to provide a value for this variable.

is_sensitive.description: Indicates if the variable value is sensitive and requires encryption.

scope.description: Scope of the variable. Allowed values: [organization, namespace, template, blueprint, stack].

scope_id.description: The ID of the resource to which the variable is attached.

type.description: Type of the variable. Allowed values: [tfVar, envVar].

operator.description: Logical operators. Allowed values: [ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, startsWith, contains].

value.description: The value associated with the operator. Input a number or string depending on the chosen operator. Use `values` field for operator of type `in`

values.description: A list of strings when using operator type `in`. For other operators use `value`

value_conditions.description: Specify conditions for the variable value using an operator and another value. Typically used for stacks launched from templates. For more information: [ControlMonkey Docs] (https://docs.controlmonkey.io/main-concepts/variables/variable-conditions)

block.description:
Creates, updates and destroys variables.
Variable can be either a Terraform variable or an Environment variable. For more information: [ControlMonkey Documentation](https://docs.controlmonkey.io/main-concepts/variables)
